title: Dual-Stream Simultaneous Translation via 2D Grid Attention
summary: Simultaneous machine translation must generate target tokens before the source input is complete. Existing approaches address this through post-hoc read-write policies, leaving the attention mechanism
raw_content: Simultaneous machine translation must generate target tokens before the source input is complete. Existing approaches address this through post-hoc read-write policies, leaving the attention mechanism unaware of bidirectional stream dependencies. We propose a dual-stream attention framework that represents source and target streams as a two-dimensional grid of hidden states and models their interaction through four structurally distinct attention types merged via joint QK Softmax normalization.
